title: Resume Upload Input
description: POST /api/users/profile/upload-resume — multipart/form-data. This schema describes the metadata fields; the actual file content arrives as a multipart 'file' field, not in JSON. Use this schema to validate the metadata sidecar (when sent as JSON in tests, or as form fields in production).

file_name.description: Original filename for display + format inference fallback.

format.description: Detected format. Server re-validates against Content-Type and the bytes' magic number.

size_bytes.description: Max 5MB. Server enforces this independently. Sized for typical PDF résumés (200-1000KB) with headroom for .docx with images.
